  "canonical_python_code": "def fit_affine_checks(command: 'numpy.ndarray', measured: 'numpy.ndarray',
                      groups: 'numpy.ndarray', levels: 'numpy.ndarray', stress_scale: float, *,
                      prior: 'numpy.ndarray | None' = None, min_span: float = 0.1,
                      consensus_tol: float = 0.002, prior_tol: float = 0.02,
                      slope_tol: float = 0.02) -> 'tuple[numpy.ndarray, numpy.ndarray]':
    '''Return affine gain/bias rows and an independent-consensus mask in levels order.

    Checks follow a positive-gain affine law within each group. Command,
    measured stress, prior bias and stress_scale share units. Span and residual
    thresholds are fractions of stress_scale. Pass historical coefficients
    explicitly; the default prior is identity. A prior-compatible pair may
    update both coefficients, otherwise only a supported offset is updated.
    Cauchy refinement has no ridge and uses twice the residual MAD with a
    floor of one tenth the consensus tolerance.
    '''
    import numpy as np

    def refine(a: 'numpy.ndarray', b: 'numpy.ndarray', tol: float) -> 'numpy.ndarray':
        import numpy as np
        from scipy.optimize import least_squares

        def residual(p: 'numpy.ndarray', design: 'numpy.ndarray', y: 'numpy.ndarray') -> 'numpy.ndarray':
            return design @ p - y

        i, j = np.triu_indices(a.size, 1)
        dx = a[j] - a[i]
        keep = np.abs(dx) >= 0.1 * np.ptp(a)
        eps = np.finfo(float).eps
        gain = max(np.median((b[j[keep]] - b[i[keep]]) / dx[keep]), eps)
        start = [gain, np.median(b - gain * a)]
        design = np.column_stack((a, np.ones(a.size)))
        r = design @ start - b
        scale = max(2.9652 * np.median(np.abs(r - np.median(r))), 0.1 * tol)
        return least_squares(residual, start, args=(design, b), loss='cauchy',
                             bounds=([eps, -np.inf], [np.inf, np.inf]), f_scale=scale).x

    x, y = np.asarray(command, dtype=float), np.asarray(measured, dtype=float)
    group, levels = np.asarray(groups), np.asarray(levels)
    if x.ndim != 1 or y.shape != x.shape or group.shape != x.shape or levels.ndim != 1:
        raise ValueError('expected aligned check vectors and group levels')
    limits = np.array([stress_scale, min_span, consensus_tol, prior_tol, slope_tol])
    if not np.isfinite(limits).all() or np.any(limits <= 0):
        raise ValueError('stress scale and tolerances must be positive and finite')
    out = np.tile([1., 0.], (levels.size, 1)) if prior is None else np.array(prior, dtype=float, copy=True)
    if out.shape != (levels.size, 2) or not np.isfinite(out).all() or np.any(out[:, 0] <= 0):
        raise ValueError('prior must give positive gains and finite biases')
    out[:, 1] /= stress_scale
    finite = np.isfinite(x) & np.isfinite(y)
    independent = np.zeros(levels.size, dtype=bool)
    for k, label in enumerate(levels):
        mask = (group == label) & finite
        a, b = x[mask] / stress_scale, y[mask] / stress_scale
        i, j = np.triu_indices(a.size, 1)
        dx = a[j] - a[i]
        keep = np.abs(dx) >= min_span
        i, j, dx = i[keep], j[keep], dx[keep]
        g = (b[j] - b[i]) / dx
        positive = g > 0
        if a.size >= 3 and positive.any():
            gp, ip = g[positive], i[positive]
            err = np.abs((b[None, :] - b[ip, None]) - gp[:, None] * (a[None, :] - a[ip, None]))
            inliers = err < consensus_tol
            count = inliers.sum(axis=1)
            pick = np.lexsort((np.minimum(err, consensus_tol).sum(axis=1), -count))[0]
            sel = inliers[pick]
            if count[pick] >= max(3, a.size // 2 + 1) and np.ptp(a[sel]) >= min_span:
                out[k] = refine(a[sel], b[sel], consensus_tol)
                independent[k] = True
                continue
        r = b - (out[k, 0] * a + out[k, 1])
        close = np.abs(r) < prior_tol
        diff = np.abs(r[j] - r[i])
        agree = positive & close[i] & close[j] & (diff < slope_tol * np.abs(dx) + consensus_tol)
        if agree.any():
            score = diff / np.abs(dx) + 0.5 * (np.abs(r[i]) + np.abs(r[j]))
            pick = np.argmin(np.where(agree, score, np.inf))
            sel = [i[pick], j[pick]]
            out[k] = refine(a[sel], b[sel], consensus_tol)
        elif close.any():
            out[k, 1] += np.median(r[close])
    out[:, 1] *= stress_scale
    return out, independent


def fit_preloaded_creep(past_stress: 'numpy.ndarray', past_durations: 'numpy.ndarray',
                       hold_stress: 'numpy.ndarray', hold_times: 'numpy.ndarray',
                       initial_memory: 'numpy.ndarray', features: 'numpy.ndarray',
                       initial_strain: 'numpy.ndarray', training_rows: 'numpy.ndarray',
                       observed_strain: 'numpy.ndarray', tau_bounds: tuple[float, float], *,
                       observed_rate: 'numpy.ndarray | None' = None, sensitivity_min: float = 1e-6) -> dict:
    '''Fit and predict two linear hereditary modes and a feature-dependent drift.

    Histories are piecewise constant, oldest first. Preload columns are measured
    stress-like states for the fast and slow modes, in that order. Supply
    calibrated stresses, dimensionless strain and reference-aligned features.
    Times and bounds share units; the initial rate uses reciprocal time units.
    Nonfinite observations are masked. Multistart Cauchy fitting uses twice the
    residual MAD and a relative 1e-6 floor, with no coefficient ridge. Returned
    coefficients are the two compliances followed by drift-rate coefficients.
    The sensitivity flag is local, not a yield or transfer test.
    '''
    import numpy as np
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares

    def log_times(q: 'numpy.ndarray', lo: float, span: float) -> 'numpy.ndarray':
        import numpy as np
        a, b = q[:2]
        return lo + span * np.array([a, a + (1. - a) * b])

    def basis(log_tau: 'numpy.ndarray', times: 'numpy.ndarray', durations: 'numpy.ndarray',
              after: 'numpy.ndarray', past: 'numpy.ndarray', hold: 'numpy.ndarray',
              initial: 'numpy.ndarray', drift: 'numpy.ndarray') -> 'tuple[numpy.ndarray, numpy.ndarray]':
        import numpy as np
        columns, derivatives = [], []
        for j, tau in enumerate(np.exp(log_tau)):
            a, b = after / tau, durations / tau
            kernel = np.exp(-a) * -np.expm1(-b)
            dkernel = a * kernel - b * np.exp(-a - b)
            age = durations.sum() / tau
            survival = np.exp(-age)
            gap = hold - past @ kernel - initial[:, j] * survival
            dgap = -(past @ dkernel) - initial[:, j] * age * survival
            u = times / tau
            f = np.r_[-np.expm1(-u), 1. / tau]
            df = np.r_[-u * np.exp(-u), -1. / tau]
            columns.append(gap[:, None] * f)
            derivatives.append(dgap[:, None] * f + gap[:, None] * df)
        return np.concatenate((np.stack(columns, axis=-1), drift), axis=-1), np.stack(derivatives, axis=-1)

    def robust_scale(r: 'numpy.ndarray', floor: float) -> float:
        import numpy as np
        return max(2.9652 * np.median(np.abs(r - np.median(r))), floor) if r.size else 1.

    def residual(q: 'numpy.ndarray', design: 'object', transform: 'object',
                 packed: tuple, lo: float, span: float, valid: 'numpy.ndarray',
                 y: 'numpy.ndarray', scale: 'numpy.ndarray') -> 'numpy.ndarray':
        A, _ = design(transform(q, lo, span), *packed)
        return (A[valid] @ q[2:] - y) / scale

    def jacobian(q: 'numpy.ndarray', design: 'object', transform: 'object',
                 packed: tuple, lo: float, span: float, valid: 'numpy.ndarray',
                 y: 'numpy.ndarray', scale: 'numpy.ndarray') -> 'numpy.ndarray':
        import numpy as np
        A, D = design(transform(q, lo, span), *packed)
        v, w = (D[valid] * q[2:4]).T
        return np.column_stack((span * (v + (1. - q[1]) * w), span * (1. - q[0]) * w, A[valid])) / scale[:, None]

    p, dt, h, t, z0, x, e0, observed = (np.asarray(v, dtype=float) for v in
        (past_stress, past_durations, hold_stress, hold_times, initial_memory,
         features, initial_strain, observed_strain))
    rows = np.asarray(training_rows)
    if p.ndim != 2 or dt.shape != (p.shape[1],) or h.shape != (len(p),) or e0.shape != h.shape or z0.shape != (len(p), 2) or x.ndim != 2 or len(x) != len(p):
        raise ValueError('incompatible history, preload, hold stress or feature arrays')
    if t.ndim != 1 or t.size < 2 or rows.ndim != 1 or not rows.size or rows.dtype.kind not in 'iu' or np.any(rows < 0) or np.any(rows >= len(p)) or observed.shape != (rows.size, t.size):
        raise ValueError('incompatible hold times, training indices or strain observations')
    if not all(np.isfinite(v).all() for v in (p, dt, h, t, z0, x, e0)):
        raise ValueError('physical arrays must be finite')
    lo, hi = tau_bounds
    if np.any(dt < 0) or np.any(t < 0) or np.ptp(t) <= 0 or not 0 < lo < hi < np.inf or not 0 < sensitivity_min < 1:
        raise ValueError('invalid time span, bounds or sensitivity threshold')
    rate = np.full(rows.size, np.nan) if observed_rate is None else np.asarray(observed_rate, dtype=float)
    if rate.shape != (rows.size,):
        raise ValueError('initial rates must match training rows')
    time_scale = float(t.max())
    stress_scale = max(np.max(np.abs(p), initial=0.), np.max(np.abs(h)), np.max(np.abs(z0))) or 1.
    p, h, z0 = p / stress_scale, h / stress_scale, z0 / stress_scale
    dt, t = dt / time_scale, t / time_scale
    after = np.r_[np.cumsum(dt[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.] if dt.size else dt
    drift = np.column_stack((np.ones(len(x)), x))[:, None, :] * np.r_[t, 1.][None, :, None]
    targets = np.column_stack((observed - e0[rows, None], rate * time_scale))
    valid = np.isfinite(targets)
    if not valid[:, :-1].any():
        raise ValueError('at least one finite hold-strain observation is required')
    y = targets[valid]
    floor = 1e-6 * (np.median(np.abs(y)) or np.max(np.abs(y)) or 1.)
    llo, lhi = np.log(np.array([lo, hi]) / time_scale)
    span = lhi - llo
    ncoef = x.shape[1] + 3
    train = (t, dt, after, p[rows], h[rows], z0[rows], drift[rows])
    starts = []
    for a, end in ((.12, .58), (.25, .75), (.42, .88), (.05, .94), (.55, .92)):
        q = np.array([a, (end - a) / (1. - a)])
        A = basis(log_times(q, llo, span), *train)[0][valid]
        starts.append(np.r_[q, np.linalg.lstsq(A, y, rcond=None)[0]])
    pilot = starts[1]
    r = basis(log_times(pilot, llo, span), *train)[0] @ pilot[2:] - targets
    scales = np.array([robust_scale(r[valid[:, j], j], floor) for j in range(targets.shape[1])])
    args = (basis, log_times, train, llo, span, valid, y)
    options = dict(jac=jacobian, loss='cauchy', x_scale='jac', max_nfev=250, ftol=1e-9,
                   bounds=(np.r_[0., 1e-7, np.full(ncoef, -np.inf)],
                           np.r_[1. - 1e-7, 1., np.full(ncoef, np.inf)]))
    s = np.broadcast_to(scales, valid.shape)[valid]
    best = None
    for start in starts:
        fit = least_squares(residual, start, args=(*args, s), **options)
        if best is None or fit.cost < best.cost:
            best = fit
    for _ in range(2):
        q = best.x
        r = basis(log_times(q, llo, span), *train)[0] @ q[2:] - targets
        curve_scale = robust_scale(r[:, :-1][valid[:, :-1]], floor)
        rate_scale = robust_scale(r[:, -1][valid[:, -1]], floor)
        s = np.broadcast_to(np.r_[np.full(t.size, curve_scale), rate_scale], valid.shape)[valid]
        best = least_squares(residual, q, args=(*args, s), **options)
    q = best.x
    logs = log_times(q, llo, span)
    A, D = basis(logs, *train)
    r = (A[valid] @ q[2:] - y) / s
    J = np.column_stack((D[valid] * q[2:4], A[valid])) / (s * np.hypot(1., r))[:, None]
    sv = np.linalg.svd(J, compute_uv=False)
    ratio = float(sv[-1] / sv[0]) if sv.size == q.size and sv[0] > 0 else 0.
    pred = basis(logs, t, dt, after, p, h, z0, drift)[0] @ q[2:]
    return dict(time_constants=np.exp(logs) * time_scale,
                coefficients=np.r_[q[2:4] / stress_scale, q[4:] / time_scale],
                strain=e0[:, None] + pred[:, :-1], initial_rate=pred[:, -1] / time_scale,
                sensitivity_ratio=ratio, identifiable=bool(best.success and ratio > sensitivity_min))


def solve_profiled_allocation(modes: 'numpy.ndarray', observed: 'numpy.ndarray',
                              nuisance: 'numpy.ndarray', upper: 'numpy.ndarray | float', budget: float, *,
                              nuisance_ridge: float, source_ridge: float,
                              strain_increment: 'numpy.ndarray | None' = None,
                              modulation: float = 0.25, tol: float = 1e-10) -> 'tuple[numpy.ndarray, dict]':
    '''Minimize the ridge-residualized least-squares objective on a box simplex.

    Optional dimensionless terminal strain increments rescale mode rows by
    1 + modulation*tanh(increment). The same ridge residual operator acts on
    design and response; the objective squares the resulting residual. Both
    positive ridges are supplied explicitly in their design Gram matrix units.
    Caps must be positive. The equality multiplier uses budget - sum(weights).
    The dual bound minimizes the objective's tangent over the box after
    dualizing equality. Internal KKT tolerances use normalized coordinates.
    '''
    import numpy as np

    S, y, Z = (np.asarray(v, dtype=float) for v in (modes, observed, nuisance))
    if S.ndim != 2 or not all(S.shape) or y.shape != (len(S),) or Z.ndim != 2 or len(Z) != len(S):
        raise ValueError('expected aligned design, response and nuisance arrays')
    n = S.shape[1]
    cap = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(upper, dtype=float), (n,))
    total = float(cap.sum())
    if not all(np.isfinite(v).all() for v in (S, y, Z, cap)) or np.any(cap <= 0) or not np.isfinite(total) or not 0 <= budget <= total:
        raise ValueError('inputs must be finite with positive caps and a feasible budget')
    if not 0 < nuisance_ridge < np.inf or not 0 < source_ridge < np.inf or not 0 < tol < 1 or not 0 <= modulation < 1:
        raise ValueError('invalid ridge, tolerance or modulation')
    if strain_increment is not None:
        delta = np.asarray(strain_increment, dtype=float)
        if delta.shape != y.shape or not np.isfinite(delta).all():
            raise ValueError('strain increment must be a finite vector matching response rows')
        S = S * (1. + modulation * np.tanh(delta))[:, None]
    if Z.shape[1]:
        both = np.column_stack((S, y))
        both -= Z @ np.linalg.solve(Z.T @ Z + nuisance_ridge * np.eye(Z.shape[1]), Z.T @ both)
        S, y = both[:, :-1], both[:, -1]
    wscale = float(cap.max())
    u, B = cap / wscale, budget / wscale
    A = S * wscale
    H0 = A.T @ A + source_ridge * wscale**2 * np.eye(n)
    b0 = A.T @ y
    scale = max(np.max(np.abs(H0)), np.max(np.abs(b0)))
    H, b = H0 / scale, b0 / scale
    if budget == 0:
        v, nu = np.zeros(n), float(np.min(-b))
    elif budget == total:
        v, nu = u.copy(), float(np.max(H @ u - b))
    else:
        v = u * (budget / total)
        active = np.zeros(n, dtype=int)
        for _ in range(8 * n * n):
            g = H @ v - b
            free = np.flatnonzero(active == 0)
            if free.size:
                G = H[np.ix_(free, free)]
                ig, io = np.linalg.solve(G, np.column_stack((g[free], np.ones(free.size)))).T
                nu = float(ig.sum() / io.sum())
                step = nu * io - ig
                if np.max(np.abs(step)) > tol:
                    limit = np.full(free.size, np.inf)
                    down, up = step < 0., step > 0.
                    limit[down] = -v[free[down]] / step[down]
                    limit[up] = (u[free[up]] - v[free[up]]) / step[up]
                    j = int(np.argmin(limit))
                    v[free] += min(1., max(0., limit[j])) * step
                    if limit[j] < 1.:
                        k = free[j]
                        active[k] = 1 if step[j] > 0 else -1
                        v[k] = u[k] if active[k] == 1 else 0.
                    continue
            else:
                nu = float(0.5 * (np.max(g[active > 0]) + np.min(g[active < 0])))
            violation = active * (g - nu)
            j = int(np.argmax(violation))
            if violation[j] <= tol:
                break
            active[j] = 0
        else:
            raise RuntimeError('box-simplex active set did not converge')
    v = np.clip(v, 0., u)
    g = H @ v - b
    lower, upper_dual = np.maximum(g - nu, 0.), np.maximum(nu - g, 0.)
    complementarity = float(lower @ v + upper_dual @ (u - v))
    if abs(v.sum() - B) > 10 * tol * n or complementarity > 10 * tol * n:
        raise RuntimeError('box-simplex solution failed its normalized KKT check')
    w = wscale * v
    r = S @ w - y
    obj = 0.5 * (r @ r + source_ridge * (w @ w))
    multiplier = nu * scale / wscale
    gradient = S.T @ r + source_ridge * w
    lower, upper_dual = np.maximum(gradient - multiplier, 0.), np.maximum(multiplier - gradient, 0.)
    dual = obj - lower @ w - upper_dual @ (cap - w) - multiplier * (w.sum() - budget)
    return w, dict(weights=w.copy(), nu_sum=float(multiplier), lam_lower=lower,
                   lam_upper=upper_dual, primal_objective=float(obj), dual_lower_bound=float(dual))",

    rates[1] = np.nan
    fit = fit_preloaded_creep(past, dt, hold, t, z, x, e0, rows, obs, (.25, 4.), observed_rate=rates)
    assert fit['identifiable'] and np.isfinite(fit['sensitivity_ratio'])
    assert all(np.isfinite(fit[k]).all() for k in ('time_constants', 'coefficients', 'strain', 'initial_rate'))
    assert_allclose(fit['time_constants'], taus, rtol=2e-5)
    assert_allclose(fit['coefficients'], theta, rtol=2e-5)
    assert_allclose(fit['strain'], curve, atol=2e-7)
    assert_allclose(fit['initial_rate'], rate, atol=2e-7)
    scaled = fit_preloaded_creep(s * past, q * dt, s * hold, q * t, s * z, x, e0,
                                rows[::-1], obs[::-1], (.25 * q, 4. * q), observed_rate=rates[::-1] / q)
    assert scaled['identifiable']
    assert_allclose(scaled['time_constants'], q * fit['time_constants'], rtol=2e-5)
    assert_allclose(scaled['coefficients'], fit['coefficients'] / [s, s, q, q, q], rtol=2e-5)
    assert_allclose(scaled['strain'], fit['strain'], atol=2e-7)
    assert_allclose(scaled['initial_rate'], fit['initial_rate'] / q, atol=2e-7)

    Z = np.array([[1.], [-1.], [2.], [.5]])
    rz, rw = .9, .2
    R = np.eye(4) - (Z @ Z.T) / (np.sum(Z**2) + rz)
    target = np.array([0., .3, .5, .7])
    y = target - np.linalg.solve(R @ R, np.array([.35, .1, .1, -.25]) - rw * target)
    delta = np.array([-.1, .4, .7, -.3])
    S = np.eye(4) / (1. + .25 * np.tanh(delta))[:, None]
    cap = np.array([.8, .9, 1., .7])
    w, cert = solve_profiled_allocation(S, y, Z, cap, 1.5, nuisance_ridge=rz, source_ridge=rw, strain_increment=delta)
    assert_allclose(w, target, atol=1e-9)
    assert_allclose(w.sum(), 1.5, atol=1e-10)
    assert np.all((0 <= w) & (w <= cap))
    g = R @ (R @ (w - y)) + rw * w
    low, up = cert['lam_lower'], cert['lam_upper']
    assert np.isfinite(np.r_[w, low, up, cert['nu_sum'], cert['primal_objective'], cert['dual_lower_bound']]).all()
    assert np.all(low >= 0) and np.all(up >= 0)
    assert_allclose(g - cert['nu_sum'] - low + up, 0., atol=1e-9)
    assert_allclose(np.r_[low * w, up * (cap - w)], 0., atol=1e-9)
    assert_allclose(cert['primal_objective'], .5 * (np.linalg.norm(R @ (w - y))**2 + rw * (w @ w)), atol=1e-9)
    assert_allclose(cert['dual_lower_bound'], cert['primal_objective'], atol=1e-9)
    order = np.array([2, 0, 3, 1])
    ws, cs = solve_profiled_allocation(S[order] / s, y[order], Z[order], s * cap, s * 1.5,
                                       nuisance_ridge=rz, source_ridge=rw / s**2, strain_increment=delta[order])
    assert_allclose(ws, s * w, atol=1e-11)
    assert_allclose(cs['primal_objective'], cert['primal_objective'], atol=1e-9)
    assert_allclose(cs['nu_sum'], cert['nu_sum'] / s, atol=1e-8)

run_self_test()"
